peers.title: Peers
peers.emptyHelp: Connect a peer using its public key or connection URI, or change the filter.
peers.forceDisconnect: Force disconnect even with active channels
peers.disconnectWarning: Disconnecting can interrupt payments and channel communication. A forced disconnect may interrupt active operations. It does not close channels.
peers.notFound: This peer was not found on this node.
peers.uri: Peer public key or connection URI
peers.uriHelp: Use a public key or pubkey@host:port. IPv6 hosts use brackets.
